notes: This paper constrains the axion-GLUON coupling (1/f_a) via theta-dependence of weak nuclear decays (40K EC and 137Cs beta decay) at Gran Sasso. The y-axis of the exclusion plot is 1/f_a in GeV^-1, NOT any of the enum coupling types. None of the enum options (AxionPhoton, AxionEDM, etc.) correctly describe the axion-gluon coupling 1/f_a. The result: axion decay constants below 1.0e14 - 3.2e10 GeV excluded for masses 3.0e-23 - 9.6e-20 eV. Data points emitted as 1/f_a in GeV^-1: at m_a=3.0e-23 eV, f_a>1.0e14 GeV so 1/f_a<1.0e-14; at m_a=9.6e-20 eV, f_a>3.2e10 GeV so 1/f_a<3.125e-11. Coupling type does not match any enum well; the closest gluon-related option would be AxionEDM (d_n) but the paper reports on the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane directly. Low extraction confidence due to coupling type ambiguity.
